title: Judgement
description: A verifier's judgement as its own signed statement, standalone so it can be handed to its holder (ADR-0012, REQ-CPL-1).

judgement.description: A judgement for one class: subject reference, class, answer and validity. Its maker and time made are the envelope's (REQ-CPL-1). Kept minimal until F-053 (DEC-16).

subject.description: The subject reference the judgement is about, the one given to this relying provider (ADR-0012).

answer.description: Yes or no. Not known and not asked are rutent's own states, never a verifier's answer (REQ-AUZ-5, REQ-CPL-1).

valid_until.description: The judgement's validity; past it, it is void (REQ-CPL-1).

holder_key.description: The holder's public key, when the judgement is handed to its holder to carry (ADR-0012). Optional until F-053 (DEC-16).
